snippet.title: Escape the Exomoon - Official Demo Launch Trailer
snippet.description: Watch the Demo Launch Trailer for Escape the Exomoon, a narrative-driven cyberpunk horror game developed by LoLight Games. Players will traverse an abandoned space colony as the last survivor of the EXO CORP. Seek the truth behind the secrets and escape in Escape the Exomoon, coming soon to PC (Steam) with a demo available now on Steam.
